description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardKeyboardTagsSearcher' that extends 'AnySoftKeyboardInlineSuggestions'. It manages tag-based search functionality within the keyboard, including handling tag extraction, suggestion list management, and interaction with preferences and quick text keys. It also contains inner classes for no-operation keyboard implementation and a custom list for tag suggestions.

classes.name: NoOpKeyboard
classes.description: A minimal implementation of Keyboard that loads a simple keyboard layout, used internally for tag extraction purposes.

classes.name: SimpleKeyboardDimens
classes.description: Implements KeyboardDimens with fixed dimensions for the no-op keyboard.

classes.name: TagsSuggestionList
classes.description: A custom list implementation for managing tag suggestions, including a magnifying glass indicator and found tags.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes preferences, quick key history, and registers preference change listener.

methods.name: updateTagExtractor
methods.description: Enables or disables the tag extractor based on preference.

methods.name: setupTagsSearcher
methods.description: Creates and sets a new TagsExtractor based on enabled quick text keys.

methods.name: setTagsSearcher
methods.description: Sets the current TagsExtractor and updates the suggest component.

methods.name: getQuickKeyHistoryRecords
methods.description: Returns the quick key history records object.

methods.name: extractKeysListListFromEnabledQuickText
methods.description: Converts enabled quick text keys into a list of key lists for tag extraction.

methods.name: isAlphabet
methods.description: Determines if a character code is considered alphabetic or a tag search character.

methods.name: isTagsSearchCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a character code is the start tag search character.

methods.name: isSuggestionAffectingCharacter
methods.description: Determines if a character affects suggestions, including tag search characters.

methods.name: pickSuggestionManually
methods.description: Handles manual suggestion selection, with special handling for tag search state.
